escena: SCENE (cinematic, Hollywood blockbuster still, a vast dark hall at night): she stands on the RIGHT half of the frame, framed from the waist up, wearing the NAVY EFEONCE SOFTSHELL JACKET over the navy polo, no lanyard, no watch, no rings. REALISTIC ADULT PROPORTIONS: camera about two meters away at chest height, 85mm, she does not lean toward the lens. Beside her, on the camera-left side, floats a flat translucent GRID of TWELVE small square tiles of light, three rows of four, about as wide as her shoulders; its left edge is at about 52 % of the frame width, and between the left edge of the frame and the grid there is a wide band of empty darkness. NINE tiles glow steady cool white-blue (#0375DB): they are in use. Exactly THREE tiles are switching off, dim and grey, almost dark: the FIRST tile of the top row (far left), the SECOND tile of the bottom row, and the LAST tile of the middle row, the one closest to her. Every other tile glows steady. Her right hand is lightly open toward the last tile of the middle row, the dim one closest to her, without touching it, as if she has just switched it off; her other arm rests relaxed at her side. The tiles are abstract light squares: no letters, no numbers, no icons, nothing legible. She looks straight into the lens with a calm, knowing half-smile. The light of the tiles paints her face and jacket; everything is cool azure and white light, the light of Efeonce; only ONE tiny point at the corner of the grid glows magenta-pink (#E86BD0) as the only accent, lighting nothing. Thin haze catches the light. The LEFT 45% of the frame is calm, deep dark studio space with only faint haze: no grid, no objects. Rich contrast, no text, no logos of any other brand.
